title: add-callsite-aligned-token-fallout-matrix-and-alert-priority-suppression
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: we keep seeing noisy token-level cost spikes that cluster by callsite (the user-facing API path / prompt template) rather than by model or tenant. Existing token histograms and per-route aggregates miss cross-token fallout patterns that indicate latent tail risk (e.g., a single prompt variant producing occasional long continuations that spike cost and latency). This PR introduces a callsite-aligned token fallout matrix: a compact N x M summary that maps token-phase buckets to callsite cohorts, enabling fast UI drilldowns and smarter alert suppression. Design: (1) an aggregator that consumes per-invocation token-phase counters and emits a fixed-size matrix keyed by callsite id and day/hour window; (2) a compact encoding for storage and transport (run-length + epoch sketch) to keep cardinality low; (3) an alert-priority-suppression engine that de-escalates alerts when a callsite shows historically bursty fallout patterns (configurable half-life + churn threshold); (4) a Grafana dashboard panel and an observability playbook to interpret fallout matrices and tune SLOs. Implementation highlights: - src/observability/fallout/aggregator.go: new aggregator service with streaming ingestion and early-aggregation hooks into the telemetry pipeline. - src/observability/encoding/compact_matrix.go: serialization helpers (RLE+sketch) and forward-compat versioning. - dashboards/grafana/fallout-matrix-panel.json: new dashboard panel with tile and flame-sparkline rendering. - tools/telemetry/canary_playbook.md: playbook for on-call to investigate fallout-driven alerts and recommended suppression settings. - config/observability.yml: new keys fallout_matrix.enabled, sampling.global_rate, suppression.half_life_minutes. Rollout plan: rollout is staged: canary on prod-observability for 3 days with sampling.global_rate=0.005, then traffic scale to 0.02 after metrics confirm no ingestion/backpressure. Alerts default to add low-priority tag for callsites with >70% churn over 72h; ops can opt-in to auto-suppress for callsites marked experimental. Backwards compatibility: fallback emits legacy per-token histograms if the compact matrix flag is disabled. Testing: unit tests for serializer/decoder and aggregator edge-cases; integration test that ingests synthetic invocation traces and asserts correct matrix shape, downstream indexing, and UI rendering. Linear references: ENG-2890 (fallout-matrix), ENG-2901 (alert-suppression playbook). Checklist: [x] aggregator impl [x] encoding test coverage [x] dashboard panel [x] playbook [x] canary rollout config [x] changelog notes.

release_notes: Introduce callsite-aligned token fallout matrix (compact encoding) and an alert-priority suppression mechanism. Adds Grafana panel and on-call playbook. Rollout is canaryed; default sampling is low. See ENG-2890/ENG-2901 for tuning guidance.
playbook_snippet: 1) If an alert is suppressed, check tools/telemetry/canary_playbook.md -> guidance for manual re-escalation. 2) To increase sensitivity, raise sampling.global_rate and re-evaluate matrix churn. 3) To opt out, set fallout_matrix.enabled=false.
notes: This PR focuses on observability and alert quality. Performance: aggregator uses bounded memory and early-aggregation to avoid OOM; encoding keeps per-callsite payloads <2KB in typical workloads. Storage impact monitored under rollout.
